official: 杉並区幼保連携型認定こども園以外の認定こども園の認定の要件を定める条例

sources.label: 令和8年第2回定例会 議案・議決結果の一覧

name: 区が認定こども園の認定基準を定める
summary: 幼保連携型以外の認定こども園については、現在、東京都の条例で認定の条件が定められています。この議案では、杉並区が職員の配置や施設設備、食事の提供などの条件を定めます。令和8年11月1日から施行し、子どもへの性暴力等の防止に関する規定は同年12月25日から施行します。
changes: 幼保連携型以外の認定こども園の認定基準を区の条例で定める
子どもの年齢に応じた職員の配置数や資格、施設設備の基準を定める
食事の提供方法や保育時間の基準を定める
設置者に、対象となる従事者の犯罪事実確認などを義務付ける
who: 幼保連携型以外の認定こども園を設置する事業者
その認定こども園を利用する子どもと保護者
why: 杉並区が児童相談所設置市に指定され、認定こども園の認定基準を区で定める必要があるためと、区は説明しています。

issues.quote: 子どもの年齢に応じた職員の配置数や資格、施設設備の基準を定める
issues.note: 第20条は、送迎等で自動車を運行する際の子どもの所在確認と、通園用自動車への見落とし防止装置の設置も定めているが、changesに記載がない。

en.name: Sets accreditation standards for non-integrated certified childcare centers
en.official: Ordinance Establishing Requirements for Accrediting Certified Childcare Centers Other Than Integrated Centers for Early Childhood Education and Care in Suginami City
en.summary: Accreditation requirements for certified childcare centers other than integrated centers for early childhood education and care are currently set by a Tokyo Metropolitan Government ordinance. Under this bill, Suginami City will set requirements for staff placement, facilities and equipment, and meal provision, among other things. The ordinance will take effect on November 1, 2026. Provisions on preventing sexual violence and other harm against children will take effect on December 25 of the same year.
changes: Set accreditation standards in a city ordinance for certified childcare centers other than integrated centers for early childhood education and care
Set standards for the number and qualifications of staff according to children's ages, and for facilities and equipment
Set standards for how meals are provided and for childcare hours
Require operators to check the criminal records of covered workers, among other things
who: Operators of certified childcare centers other than integrated centers for early childhood education and care
Children and parents or guardians who use those centers
en.why: Suginami City says it needs to set the accreditation standards because it was designated as a city responsible for establishing a child guidance center.
